title: Hackathon Winners
summary: Teams that placed at inter-college hackathons, and the projects they shipped in under a day.
criteria: Top-three finish at an external or internal hackathon

title: Open Source Contributors
summary: Members whose pull requests were merged into public repositories maintained by someone else.
criteria: A merged PR to a project outside Kryptonex

title: Internship Achievers
summary: Members who converted community work into an industry internship — and the portfolio that got them there.
criteria: A secured internship attributable to community work

title: Research Papers
summary: Published or accepted work, from conference papers to security disclosures and technical writeups.
criteria: A published paper, disclosure or accepted submission

title: Top Volunteers
summary: The people who set up the lab, ran the registration desk, and stayed until the chairs were stacked.
criteria: Sustained contribution across a semester of events

title: Outstanding Member
summary: One member each season whose work raised the standard for everyone around them.
criteria: Awarded once per season by the council
